sponsorDeals.title: Starter fit review
sponsorDeals.bestFor: A sponsor wants to know whether their product is safe and relevant before buying a visible placement.

campaignVideos.title: Compress PDF to 1MB
campaignVideos.captionEn: PDF upload blocked by a 1MB limit? This free no-upload tool tries to compress scans and image-heavy PDFs in your browser.
campaignVideos.captionZh: 表格要求 PDF 小于 1MB？这个免费工具在浏览器里压缩，不用上传文件，适合扫描件和图片型 PDF，下载前记得检查效果。

campaignVideos.title: Compress PDF to 500KB
campaignVideos.captionEn: When a form asks for a tiny 500KB PDF, use a no-upload compressor and check the result before submitting.
campaignVideos.captionZh: 遇到 500KB 的 PDF 上传限制，可以先用这个无上传压缩工具试一下。压得越小画质可能越差，提交前一定检查。

campaignVideos.title: Compress Image to 100KB
campaignVideos.captionEn: Photo upload too large? Compress an image toward 100KB locally in the browser, without creating an account.
campaignVideos.captionZh: 照片超过 100KB 被表单拒绝？这个工具可以在浏览器本地压缩，不需要注册账号，也不用上传原图。

campaignVideos.title: Compress Image to 50KB
campaignVideos.captionEn: Need a very small 50KB image? Try browser-local compression and review the preview before uploading it anywhere.
campaignVideos.captionZh: 如果系统要求图片小于 50KB，可以先用这个本地压缩工具试一下。50KB 很小，预览确认后再提交。

campaignVideos.title: PDF to JPG Without Upload
campaignVideos.captionEn: If a form rejects PDF but accepts JPG, convert PDF pages to images locally in the browser.
campaignVideos.captionZh: 有些表单不要 PDF、只收 JPG。这个工具可以在浏览器里把 PDF 页面转成图片，不用上传文件。

campaignVideos.title: Remove Background Without Upload
campaignVideos.captionEn: For simple white or solid backgrounds, remove the background locally and export a transparent PNG.
campaignVideos.captionZh: 白底商品图、Logo 或签名扫描件，可以试试这个本地去背景工具。它适合简单背景，不是人像精修工具。
